## Runbook: Web Tier Unresponsive
1. Check web-vm-01/02/03 (diagram: Web Tier, East US 2)
2. Connect via bastion-vm (diagram: Management subnet)
3. Restart IIS: Restart-Service W3SVC
4. Still down? Escalate: Platform on-call (PagerDuty)
caption: Every step points back at a box on the diagram -- that's why they're written together.
